description: A heavy, cheap survey quad with a bulky sensor pod. Launch it and stand still at its laptop: you fly it with your movement keys and the camera follows it up to 30 m away, while its radar (18 m around it) marks terrain, ore and hostiles for you and your party. Moving or getting hit drops the link and it flies home. Draws 0.5 energy a second from your worn cell, 90 seconds a flight. Needs Tech 2. Relay Nine stock; Rask sells it in Dustline.
